summary: Day-1 security + perf audit regression. 32/32 new audit tests pass + 12/12 pre-existing cancel tests still pass. Frontend smoke: all 9 admin lazy tabs render correct panels; Dashboard renders Upcoming/Past/Cancelled tabs with counts. No regressions found. C1/C2/C3/C4/H1/H4/H2/H5/M1/M3 all verified.

design_issues.screen: Admin > Add Schedule (and other forms with terminal <select>)
issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by emergent instrumentation injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> children. Cosmetic console warning only — dropdowns still function. Not introduced by this audit batch but still worth noting.

critical_code_review_comments: C1 JWT rotation verified: tokens forged with old placeholder secret 'change-me-in-production-...' return 401 on /auth/me; new login → /auth/me 200.
C2 verified at curl + test level: /api/health response has NO 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true' header; bearer-token cross-origin still works.
C3 verified: backend logs grep for literal 'Admin@123' returns 0 matches; admin login still succeeds (BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD env in .env preserves bootstrap behaviour).

C4 ownership: GET /api/bookings/{id} correctly returns 200 for owner, 200 for admin, 200 for guest with matching ?email=, 403 for non-owner authed user, 403 for guest with wrong email, 403 for guest with no email — all 6 cases pass.
H1 ReDoS-safe: re.escape() applied at server.py:487 (terminals) and audit-logs path. Tested with .*(.*).* / ^(a+)+$ / (((((((((a))))))))).* / [invalid — all return 200 quickly (<1s).
H4 /api/payments/options/{id} now correctly enforces auth/email — was previously open. 5/5 access-control test cases pass.
Perf H5 cache verified: back-to-back /api/popular/now returns identical 'generated_at' (within 30s TTL window).
Perf H2 search aggregation works: schedules array each carry seats_available within [0, total_seats].
Perf M1 /api/bookings/me: from/to terminal objects populated via single batched query (server.py:1348-1352).
Perf M3 /api/admin/stats and /api/admin/feedback shapes intact (users/bookings/confirmed_bookings/terminals/schedules and summary{total,new,in_progress,resolved}+items[]).
Cancellation regression: /api/bookings/{id}/cancellation-quote returns 401 unauthed and 403 for non-owner — verified with both pre-existing test_cancel_booking.py and new test_audit_day1.py cases.
Frontend: PaymentCallback.jsx line 105 correctly appends ?email=<contact_email> to /bookings/{id} link only when booking.user_id is null — verified by code inspection.
Frontend: BookingDetail.jsx now reads ?email= from URL for guest access (verified by C4 guest test passing through same backend endpoint).

Frontend: Admin.jsx all 9 React.lazy tabs (bookings/payments/schedules/add-schedule/terminals/promo-codes/feedback/audit-log/admins) load on demand and render their data-testid panels with no console errors except known instrumentation warning.
Frontend: Dashboard renders /dashboard with 3 stat cards + tabs (Upcoming/Past/Cancelled) + correct counts. Tab testids are 'bookings-tab-{upcoming|past|cancelled}' (not 'dashboard-tab-*').
Code quality (carried over): server.py is 2884 lines — recommend splitting into routers (auth/bookings/admin/payments) per <700-line guideline.
